detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

ARA-290 (Cibinetide Peptide)

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C₅₁H₈₄N₁₆O₂₁
  • Molecular Weight: ~1257.3 g/mol
  • Sequence: Asp-Glu-Leu-Asp-Ser-Thr-Ser-Ser-Glu-Glu-Leu-Leu-Lys-Glu-Arg
    (15-amino-acid erythropoietin Helix-B surface peptide)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

ARA-290 is a synthetic peptide consisting of a defined 15–amino-acid sequence. It is produced via peptide synthesis and supplied for use in controlled laboratory research environments.

Supplied as a lyophilized peptide powder, ARA-290 is intended exclusively for in-vitro laboratory research where high-purity peptide material is required.

Research Applications:

ARA-290 is studied in controlled laboratory settings for:

  • Characterization of peptide structural properties in vitro
  • Analysis of peptide stability and degradation profiles
  • Investigation of physicochemical properties of synthetic peptide sequences
  • Evaluation of peptide behavior under controlled laboratory conditions
  • Analytical profiling of peptide consistency and composition
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C
  • After reconstitution, maintain at 2–8 °C
  • Use promptly after reconstitution
  • Handle using standard aseptic laboratory technique
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in aqueous laboratory buffers; solubility varies with pH and medium
Compliance Notice:

ARA-290 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
